cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our school trip now needs two signatures on every consent form. Reassuring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. We'll have to wait for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Good. Independent eyes before any child boards a bus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She wants someone else to check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. We've found a safeguard our second safeguard needed. Who's checking that third person?

confusable: D190 processes an individual request; D188 praises the increased thoroughness of successive restrictions.
comparison: Collaborative trip administration differs from commercial closure advertising.
seedUse: Keep June as form author; make A correct genuinely nonindependent checking rather than merely ask an extra checker.
